job: Fly across oceans without fossil fuel
bottleneck: Batteries hold about 1/50 the energy per kg of jet fuel

job: Cross a continent in an hour
bottleneck: Supersonic flight burns several times the fuel and the boom bans it over land
target: Coast to coast in an hour at an airline fare

job: See and map the deep ocean
bottleneck: Radio and light die within metres of seawater, so only sound reaches far, and it carries little data
target: The whole seafloor mapped in detail; live sensing anywhere

job: Keep coral reefs alive through heatwaves
bottleneck: Corals expel their algae and starve after a few weeks 1°C above normal
target: Reefs that survive the heatwaves of the 2040s

job: Learn a skill or language much faster
bottleneck: Memory sets during sleep at its own slow pace; practice time is the limit
target: Half the practice for the same skill

job: A personal tutor for every child
bottleneck: One-on-one tutoring roughly doubles learning but costs a teacher per child
Metal detectors also beep for every nail and shell fragment, about 1,000 false alarms per mine, and each must be dug by hand
target: A field cleared 10× faster, no one at risk

job: Warn of an earthquake before it strikes
bottleneck: No reliable precursor is known; today's systems give seconds of warning once shaking has started

job: Put out wildfires while they're small
bottleneck: Fires start in remote places and are spotted and reached late
target: Every fire found within minutes and out within the hour

bottleneck: Dogs, cameras and listening devices reach only some voids; most survivors must be found within 72 hours
target: Every living person located in the first day

bottleneck: Damage starts 15-20 years before symptoms, and most drugs can't cross the blood-brain barrier
target: Found and halted before any memory is lost

bottleneck: The ear's hair cells never grow back in mammals; hearing aids only amplify
The eye's lens stiffens with age and can't refocus up close
The retina's light-sensing cells die and don't come back
Cartilage has no blood supply and doesn't heal; the fix is a metal joint
target: Your own knee back, no replacement

job: Heal a heart after a heart attack
bottleneck: Heart muscle doesn't regrow; scar tissue weakens the heart for life

job: Stay strong and steady in old age
bottleneck: Muscle and bone thin after 50, and falls become the leading cause of injury death in the elderly
